# Relay Inventory API

> Relay is a sneaker resale marketplace. The Inventory API lets approved sellers sync inventory, manage size variants, update pricing, and deactivate listings programmatically.

Base URL: https://relayco.app

## Authentication
Bearer token using a Relay API key. Keys have prefix `relay_sk_test_` (staging) or `relay_sk_live_` (production). Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

## Endpoints

- [Inventory Upsert](https://relayco.app/api#upsert): POST /api/integrations/inventory/upsert - Create or merge SKU listings with mixed DS/new + used inventory support, itemized used-pair photos, and optional multipart photo uploads.
- [Variant Update](https://relayco.app/api#variant): PATCH /api/integrations/inventory/variant - Update quantity, price, or active status for one variant.
- [Bulk Price Update](https://relayco.app/api#prices): PATCH /api/integrations/inventory/prices - Reprice multiple SKU-size pairs in one request.
- [Deactivate Listing](https://relayco.app/api#deactivate): POST /api/integrations/inventory/deactivate - Soft-deactivate all sizes under a SKU.
- [Deactivate Variant](https://relayco.app/api#deactivate-variant): POST /api/integrations/inventory/deactivate-variant - Soft-deactivate one size under a SKU.

## Rate Limits
60 requests per minute per API key. Exceeding returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header.

## Full Reference
https://relayco.app/llms-full.txt - complete API reference in plain markdown
https://relayco.app/openapi.json - OpenAPI 3.0 specification
